title: GLAST-positive small extracellular-vesicle total-RNA sequencing in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a 60-participant discovery cohort
description: Total-RNA sequencing of a plasma-derived, GLAST-positive small extracellular-vesicle fraction was performed in a discovery cohort of 60 participants, including 45 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and 15 non-neurological controls. One total-RNA sequencing library was generated per participant using the SMARTer Stranded Total RNA-Seq Kit v3 – Pico Input Mammalian and sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 at the Yale Center for Genome Analysis. This Series contains the total-RNA sequencing data. Matched small-RNA sequencing was performed from the same vesicle RNA eluate and is deposited in a companion GEO Series. The data were generated to characterize extracellular-vesicle RNA cargo and identify molecular features associated with ALS and clinical progression.
